name: Jitream
title: David's sixth son
summary: Jitream was the sixth son of King David, born to his wife Eglah in Hebron. He is mentioned in the lists of David's sons who were born during his reign in Hebron, before he became king over all Israel.

keyEvents.title: Born in Hebron
keyEvents.description: Ithream was born as David's sixth son in Hebron, while David reigned over the tribe of Judah for seven and a half years.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy
keyEvents.description: Ithream is also recorded in the genealogies of Chronicles as David's sixth son, born to Eglah.
